title: VWP-Bench public fact catalog
description: The public catalog of common accounting fact types (VWP-Bench proposal, Stage 1). Names possible facts only — it never reveals which facts matter in a case or what their values are. Both arms (models and CPA control) receive the same catalog; the private case key of material facts stays with the graders.

factType.description: Namespaced fact type (benchmark convention: asc606.*, asc820.*, contract.*, entity.*).

valueShape.description: Conventional value shape when the fact is captured (spec/facts.md §5).
